summary: ON Semiconductor Corp filed an 8-K on May 6, 2026, announcing a private offering of $1.3 billion aggregate principal amount of Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, with an option for underwriters to purchase an additional $200.0 million. The offering is exempt under Rule 144A. Net proceeds will be used to pay for convertible note hedge transactions, repurchase up to $400.0 million of common stock concurrently, and for general corporate purposes including debt repayment. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction (convertible note offering) and does not constitute a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The convertible note offering and associated stock repurchase are ordinary financing activities, not a special situation category event.
